slots.name: accused officers
slots.sentence: "Authorities have charged or accused at least 50 law-enforcement officers of using license-plate readers for unauthorized purposes, including to stalk women without their knowledge or consent," they reported. Flock's system was involved in 46 of those cases.

slots.name: jail time
slots.sentence: He recently testified at a US Senate hearing alongside Lindsey Isaacs, who spent 13 days in jail after investigators wrongly linked her vehicle to a fatal hit-and-run, relying in part on images of her vehicle captured by a Flock camera.
